name: betweenness_centrality
author: f6f61ae0
description: Ranks nodes by exact Brandes betweenness: the fraction of shortest paths between other nodes passing through each node. Use to find brokers between groups. Supports directed and undirected graphs. By default weights are ignored; weighted=true treats finite positive weights as distances. Returns up to top_k node references with six-decimal scores, ordered by descending score then ascending ID. Endpoints are excluded.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Maximum entries per result list; byte limit may reduce this further.

normalized.description: Normalize by possible endpoint pairs, including unreachable pairs.

weighted.description: Treat edge weights as positive distances; false counts hops.
